hooks.text: 六边形地块不受地形限制，可依直觉自由摆放
hooks.excerpt: Unlike other city- and hex-tile building games, in Qianli you won’t be limited by any terrain restrictions. Place each piece freely, following only your instinct. You may be chasing a high score, or simply enjoying a peaceful session of beauty and creation: the choice is yours.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 道路接水生成码头，山峰旁小径显现古寺门扉
hooks.excerpt: But magic happens when certain tiles meet: a path reaching water forms a dock, a trail near a famed peak reveals the gates of an ancient temple.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 以《千里江山图》为源的中国水墨青绿画卷
hooks.excerpt: Qianli: The Vastscape Scroll offers its unique twist to the genre along with a breathtaking art style, inspired by A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains, one of the most beautiful masterpieces of Chinese ink and watercolor art.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 静音音效设置没有实际生效

excerpts.excerpt: I cannot seem to mute the sound effects, despite it showing that it is in fact muted.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分地块尤其道路难以辨认

excerpts.excerpt: 有时候会分不清摆放的是哪个地块，特别是道路。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分界面元素与整体美术风格不协调。

excerpts.excerpt: “任务”“连击“的UI跟美术风格完全不搭。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 景物的人设很优秀，配音的感情和语气也都很到位
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 青绿山水国风美术看起来舒适。

excerpts.excerpt: 青绿山水画风看着舒心
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: I love the art; it is absolutely gorgeous.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期探索模式步数偏紧。

excerpts.excerpt: 探索模式后期步数略紧
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 长时间操作后仍可能因灵力不足而整局失败。

excerpts.excerpt: 花一个多小时走了二百多步发现灵力还没够，直接白打
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 通关后无法回看已完成的造景。

excerpts.excerpt: 目前通完一关没法回顾自己造的景，算是小遗憾
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 国风拼图玩法令人上头。

excerpts.excerpt: 造景与拼图结合玩起来很上头
